about: Science Museum Group Collection (collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk), the online catalogue of over 500,000 museum objects and archives. This CLI reads only the public homepage: featured collections, top-level collection categories, and 'on this day' anniversary highlights.

commands.summary: List the featured collections shown in the homepage 'Explore' carousel (for example BBC Heritage Collection), with title, description and link
List the top-level collection themes on the homepage (for example Medicine), with their description and subcategory text (for example Pharmacology, Surgery, Asian medicine)
List the homepage 'anniversary' highlights: collection objects linked to events from N years ago today, with the anniversary text and a link to the object
